A.allowed_thesis_wording: The bounded evidence-bound pipeline produced verifier-admissible rules for confirmed relations in this 42-relation cohort.
A.direct_evidence: T0, T1, and T1-B each accepted 42/42; T2 accepted 39/42.
A.limitations: Deterministic validity is not utility or detector benefit.
A.prohibited_overclaim: The constructed rules improve anomaly detection.

B.allowed_thesis_wording: One frozen T1 call yielded an admissible proposal for every relation in this cohort and run.
B.counter_evidence: None within T1 in this run.
B.direct_evidence: 42 calls, 42 valid structured proposals, 42 admissible proposals, 42 accepted relations.
B.limitations: One cohort, model snapshot, and realized run; no general reliability claim.
B.prohibited_overclaim: LLMs reliably construct valid CPS rules in general.

C.allowed_thesis_wording: Repeated independent sampling recovered one first-draw rejection and tolerated one unrelated parse failure, at 84 extra calls.
C.counter_evidence: Final yield did not exceed the separate T1 arm; call 2 recovered zero relations.
C.direct_evidence: T1-B yield progressed 41, 41, 42; all relations accepted; one parse failure did not affect its relation.
C.limitations: Only one realized sequence and one parse failure.
C.prohibited_overclaim: Best-of-three generally improves validity or provider reliability.

D.allowed_thesis_wording: Incremental validity benefit of T2 was not observed, and its feedback mechanism was not empirically exercised.
D.counter_evidence: T1 and T1-B reached 42/42 while T2 reached 39/42.
D.direct_evidence: Zero revise, retrieve, follow-up, or recovery actions; three deterministic non-repairable no_rule outcomes.
D.limitations: The run evaluates the realized controller path, not an activated feedback-recovery path.

E.allowed_thesis_wording: T2 used one-third of T1-B's calls but lost three accepted relations; T1 dominated both on this validity/cost frontier.
E.counter_evidence: T2's 42 calls were cheaper than T1-B's 126.
E.direct_evidence: T2 39/42 at 42 calls versus T1-B 42/42 at 126; T1 42/42 at 42.
E.limitations: No preregistered acceptable-loss threshold and no utility outcome.
E.prohibited_overclaim: T2 provides the best efficiency-quality trade-off.

F.allowed_thesis_wording: Direct estimation was structurally valid but materially inaccurate, supporting deterministic calibration for this contract.
F.counter_evidence: No missing, nonfinite, parse, or sign-domain failures occurred.
F.direct_evidence: Median normalized errors were 0.598, 0.490, and 0.984; target-noise mean was 39.604.
F.limitations: Descriptive frozen-cohort evidence; utility remains untested.
F.prohibited_overclaim: LLMs cannot estimate numeric parameters in any setting.

G.allowed_thesis_wording: The deterministic verifier/controller prevented three non-repairable unsupported-variable proposals from becoming accepted rules.
G.counter_evidence: No repairable case exercised feedback recovery.
G.direct_evidence: Three T2 proposals had VALIDITY_UNSUPPORTED_VARIABLE and terminated as no_rule.
G.limitations: Safety is established only at deterministic validity admission, not runtime or utility.

H.allowed_thesis_wording: Exploratory origin summaries show no META no_rule outcomes and two GDN-member no_rule outcomes, but cannot establish an origin effect.
H.counter_evidence: Memberships overlap and GDN has only five relations.
H.direct_evidence: T2 accepted META 28/28, STAT 30/32, GDN 3/5; other arms accepted every subgroup relation.
H.limitations: Non-exclusive exploratory groups, small GDN membership, no causal or powered subgroup design.
H.prohibited_overclaim: Candidate origin materially determines construction success.
